verdict.rationale: Reviewing a public CVE/security-advisory history is a fair question for a widely used UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no security advisories page, CVE list, GitHub security advisories, or disclosure policy. The only security-related item, 'Get Security Updates for Vue 2', is about receiving patches for an older version. That is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward a reviewable disclosure track record.
